text:
alex: quick sync — ran the degrade-mode simulator against a canary traffic dump and the KPI outputs look off. wondering if the sim models KV-cache hits and batching properly.
maya: can you paste the run id + config? PMs want this surfaced in the rollout preview.
alex: run id sim-20260303-482. config snippet:
```json
{
  "degrade_mode": "graceful",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "kv_cache": true,
  "fallback": { "model": "small-safe", "threshold": 0.7 },
  "sanitizePrompts": true
}
```
devon: looked quickly — simulator currently ignores batch_size override if traffic sample includes explicit batching metadata. bug: batch override gets skipped when sample.metadata.batch_hint exists. i can patch tonight.
sam: telemetry FYI — sim emits event rollout.sim.run with metrics: p95_token_latency_ms, p50_latency_ms, fallback_rate, tokens_saved_pct, cache_hit_rate, quality_score. we persist sim metrics to sim_runs, but we don't currently snapshot the input prompts into the audit index. we should store config + seed + a redacted sample for forensic replay.
maya: product ask — PMs want an exportable "audit snapshot" you can attach to a rollout: config, metric timeseries, and a trace of route decisions. download as JSON+trace.
alex: +1 but need to avoid PII leakage. sanitizePrompts flag should redact prompt text (replace with hash or placeholder) before saving to audit.
devon: quick patch idea:
```diff
- runConfig.batch = sample.metadata.batch_hint || runConfig.batch
+ runConfig.batch = runConfig.batch_override || sample.metadata.batch_hint || runConfig.batch
+ if (runConfig.sanitizePrompts) redact(sample.requests)
```
I'll open a PR.
ops-bot: sim run completed: sim-20260303-482 status=finished. metrics: fallback_rate=2.4%, p95_token_latency_ms=52, tokens_saved_pct=18.3%, cache_hit_rate=72.1%, quality_score=0.973. trace: /sim/482/trace (internal link).
sam: quick cost calc for context — baseline model $0.12 per 1k tokens -> $120 per 1M tokens. tokens_saved ~18.3% -> ~$22 saved per 1M tokens. but fallback latency and extra model ops can change unit cost; we should show conservative bounds in the UI.
maya: UX question — do we show raw timeseries + traces in the console or a single simulation verdict with an expand option? i lean verdict + open traces for advanced users. verdict should include: expected cost delta, p95 latency delta, fallback_rate, quality_regression_risk.
alex: final ask — sim runs must generate an audit entry that can timeline-replay: config, redacted sample requests, raw metric series, and the route decisions snapshot. anyone object to adding that to the rollout preview?
devon: no objections. i'll add the batch fix + snapshot export endpoints in the PR.
sam: i'll own retention policy for sim artifacts. proposal: keep full exports 90 days, aggregated metrics 1 year, and allow on-demand archive to S3 for customers.
maya: sounds good, also add a small CTA in the rollout UI: "Attach sim snapshot to rollout" with checkbox and note about redaction.
alex: perfect — thanks. ping me when PR is up and i'll run another sim. :thumbsup:
